parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the merchant request.
The value is a 32-character alphanumeric string. The first few characters are a custom abbreviation defined by the merchant, the middle part can be a time segment, and the last part can be a random or incremental sequence
parameters.help_zh:
商户请求的唯一标识。
值为32位长度的字母数字组合。前面几位字符是商户自定义的简称，中间可以使用一段时间，后段可以使用一个随机或递增序列
parameters.name: outer_order_no

parameters.help_en:
The certificate type.
Currently only ID cards are supported. You must set this parameter to IDENTITY_CARD
parameters.help_zh:
证件类型。
当前支持身份证，必须传入IDENTITY_CARD
parameters.name: cert_type

parameters.help_en: The device token for risk identification
parameters.name: device_token

parameters.help_en: The mobile phone number of the user
parameters.name: mobile

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the user
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The custom user ID defined by the business
parameters.help_zh: 客户业务自定义的用户ID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The OSS photo URL. Currently only authorized OSS photo URLs are supported.

Among the four methods of passing in images (FaceContrastPicture, FaceContrastPictureUrl, CertifyId, and OSS), select only one
parameters.help_zh:
OSS照片地址，目前只支持已授权OSS照片地址。

在FaceContrastPicture、FaceContrastPictureUrl、CertifyId、OSS四种传入图片方式中，选择其中一种传入即可
parameters.name: face_contrast_picture_url

parameters.help_en:
The CertifyId from a previous successful ID Verification. The photo from that verification is used as the comparison photo.

Among the four methods of passing in images (FaceContrastPicture, FaceContrastPictureUrl, CertifyId, and OSS), select only one
parameters.help_zh:
之前实人认证通过的CertifyId，认证时的照片作为比对照片。

在FaceContrastPicture、FaceContrastPictureUrl、CertifyId、OSS四种传入图片方式中，选择其中一种传入即可
parameters.name: certify_id

parameters.help_en:
The bucket name of the authorized OSS space.

Among the four methods of passing in images (FaceContrastPicture, FaceContrastPictureUrl, CertifyId, and OSS), select only one
parameters.help_zh:
已授权OSS空间的Bucket 名 。

在FaceContrastPicture、FaceContrastPictureUrl、CertifyId、OSS四种传入图片方式中，选择其中一种传入即可
parameters.name: oss_bucket_name

parameters.help_en:
The file name in the authorized OSS space.

Among the four methods of passing in images (FaceContrastPicture, FaceContrastPictureUrl, CertifyId, and OSS), select only one
parameters.help_zh:
已授权OSS空间的文件名。

在FaceContrastPicture、FaceContrastPictureUrl、CertifyId、OSS四种传入图片方式中，选择其中一种传入即可
parameters.name: oss_object_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow cropping of the face image. Valid values:

T: Allowed.

F (default): Not allowed
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许裁剪人脸图片：

T：允许剪裁

F（默认）：不允许剪裁
parameters.name: crop

parameters.help_en: The encryption type. An empty value indicates no encryption
parameters.help_zh: 加密类型。为空表示不加密
parameters.name: encrypt_type

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure
Code.description_zh: 返回码：200为成功，其他为失败

CertifyId.description_en: The unique identifier of the ID Verification request
CertifyId.description_zh: 实人认证请求的唯一标识

IdentityInfo.description_en: The subject information of the verification. This is returned as empty in common verification scenarios
IdentityInfo.description_zh: 认证的主体信息，一般的认证场景返回为空

MaterialInfo.description_en: The supplementary material information of the verification subject, primarily image-based materials, in JSON format as follows
MaterialInfo.description_zh: 认证主体附件信息，主要为图片类材料，JSON格式，如下

Passed.description_en: Indicates whether the verification is passed. A value of T indicates passed. A value of F indicates not passed
Passed.description_zh: 是否通过，通过为T，不通过为F

SubCode.description_en: The verification result description. For more information, see the SubCode description below
SubCode.description_zh: 认证结果描述。详情见下方SubCode 说明
